name: agentfox
description: Operator plugin for the AgentFox control plane in Codex CLI: onboard an agent codebase, triage findings, author and simulate policy, gate evals in CI, red-team, export audit evidence and respond to incidents, with a hook that refuses agent-run commands which change what is blocked.
